title: MACD/RSI/KDJ triple-indicator reading
body:
# MACD/RSI/KDJ triple-indicator reading

- **MACD** shows trend direction (slowest; main trend).
- **RSI** shows overbought/oversold (mid sensitivity; entry/exit).
- **KDJ** shows short-term turning points (fastest; swing timing).

## Triple resonance (strongest signal)

- Long resonance: MACD golden cross or bullish divergence + RSI <30 or crossing above 50 + KDJ K<30 golden cross or J<0.
- Short resonance: MACD death cross or bearish divergence + RSI >70 or crossing below 50 + KDJ K>70 death cross or J>100.

## Priority when indicators disagree

1. Trend first (MACD): in confirmed uptrends, ignore RSI/KDJ overbought flags.
2. Extremes first (RSI<20/>80 or KDJ<0/>100): respect extreme-zone signals even when MACD has not turned.
3. Divergence wins: price-vs-indicator divergence is the most reliable signal; trust it over other readings.
rationale: novel topic for a trading-indicators project — existing wiki has no coverage of MACD/RSI/KDJ interplay
